def transform(a, exterior_conn=4, band_conn=8):
 H=len(a);W=len(a[0]); ds4=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]; ds8=[(i,j) for i in (-1,0,1) for j in (-1,0,1) if i or j]; ds=ds4 if exterior_conn==4 else ds8
 outside=set();q=deque()
 for r in range(H):
  for c in range(W):
   if (r in (0,H-1) or c in (0,W-1)) and a[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in outside: outside.add((r,c));q.append((r,c))
 while q:
  r,c=q.popleft()
  for dr,dc in ds:
   p=r+dr,c+dc
   if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and a[p[0]][p[1]]==0 and p not in outside: outside.add(p);q.append(p)
 inside={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in outside}
 unseen={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r][c]==1}; comps=[]
 while unseen:
  s=unseen.pop();comp={s};q=[s]
  while q:
   r,c=q.pop()
   for dr,dc in ds4:
    p=r+dr,c+dc
    if p in unseen:unseen.remove(p);comp.add(p);q.append(p)
  comps.append(comp)
 inner=set();halo=set()
 bds=ds8 if band_conn==8 else ds4
 for comp in comps:
  adjinside=set();adjout=set()
  for r,c in comp:
   for dr,dc in bds:
    p=r+dr,c+dc
    if p in inside:adjinside.add(p)
    elif 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and a[p[0]][p[1]]==0 and p in outside:adjout.add(p)
  has4=any((r+dr,c+dc) in inside for r,c in comp for dr,dc in ds4)
  if has4:inner|=adjinside;halo|=adjout
 out=[row[:] for row in a]
 for r,c in halo:out[r][c]=2
 for r,c in inner:out[r][c]=3
 return out,inside,inner,halo
